title: MAVEN: A Multi-stage Agentic Annotation Pipeline for Video Reasoning Tasks
abstract: MAVEN is a multi-stage agentic pipeline for turning raw videos into structured Chain-of-Thought training data around an Event of Focus. It synthesizes a Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal Event Description from global, dense, and chunk-level captions, uses that intermediate to generate multi-task Q&A, and supports agent-driven domain adaptation plus hierarchical refinement from human feedback. Applied to over 5,300 traffic videos, MAVEN-labeled data improves Cosmos-Reason2-8B on private CCTV evaluation and AccidentBench, with RL post-training surpassing Gemini baselines.
